evolution.title: The Power of Evolution
evolution.desc: Evolution is nature's most proven way to create intelligence. EvoX brings that loop to AI: generate many candidates, test them for real, keep what works, and build on it — so capability compounds through experiment instead of hand-tuning.

runtime.hero.subtitle: GPU-Accelerated Evolutionary Computation Framework
runtime.hero.desc: EvoX Runtime is a distributed, GPU-accelerated framework for scalable evolutionary computation — 30+ algorithms for single- and multi-objective optimization, neuroevolution, and evolutionary reinforcement learning, fully compatible with PyTorch.
genesis.hero.subtitle: Recursive Agentic System
genesis.hero.desc: Genesis decomposes any project — from a blank slate to millions of lines of code — and drives it to completion. Every agent works in its own isolated, sandboxed Git worktree, so parallel execution scales without limits. Fully autonomous, from first idea to shipped software.
genesis.model.title: Two dimensions of understanding.
genesis.model.desc: Genesis reads a project the way a team would — by place and by history. The spatial axis tells every agent exactly where it stands and what belongs there; the temporal axis records how each version of the code came to exist, and why it survived.
genesis.model.space.title: Knows where everything lives.
genesis.model.space.desc: Every directory carries a CONTEXT.md — a short semantic contract stating intent, invariants and routing. Agents never reverse-engineer the architecture; it is written down exactly where they work.
genesis.model.time.title: Remembers how it got here.
genesis.model.time.desc: Every change lands on a branch of the Git DAG. Candidate implementations compete on measurable merit — and partial progress is preserved, never discarded.
genesis.why.scale.title: Scales without limits
genesis.why.scale.desc: Recursive decomposition keeps every agent's context small. The system grows by dividing work, not by inflating one window.
genesis.why.evolve.title: Evolves, doesn't just generate
genesis.why.evolve.desc: Code grows through a Git DAG where incremental, measurable improvement always wins. Dead ends become fossils.
genesis.why.sandbox.title: Sandboxed by default
genesis.why.sandbox.desc: Generated code runs inside your platform's native sandbox: systemd-run on Linux, sandbox-exec on macOS, direct execution on Windows.
genesis.cta.title: Get Genesis
genesis.cta.subtitle: Start evolving.
genesis.phases.title: Start from a prompt. Or from today.
genesis.phases.g.title: Genesis — create.
genesis.phases.g.desc: Describe the system you want. Genesis drafts an architecture, decomposes it into tasks, and grows a working codebase from nothing — every step committed to a fresh Git history.
genesis.phases.e.title: Evolution — improve.
genesis.phases.e.desc: Point Genesis at an existing repository and state an objective. It reads the Context Tree, plans the change, and evolves the code through candidate lineages — improvements are kept, dead ends become fossils.

libs.heroDesc: A collection of libraries, tools, and projects designed to accelerate computation and optimization research.
libs.empty: No libraries found in the collection.
libs.desc.evox: A distributed GPU-accelerated evolutionary computation framework compatible with PyTorch.
libs.desc.evogit: A decentralized multi-agent framework that reimagines software development as a collaborative, evolutionary process.
libs.desc.evogp: A fully GPU-accelerated Tree-based Genetic Programming (TGP) framework built on PyTorch.
libs.desc.evorl: A fully GPU-accelerated framework for Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning.
libs.desc.evomo: A GPU-accelerated library for evolutionary multiobjective optimization (EMO) via advanced tensorization.
libs.desc.tensorneat: A JAX-based library for NeuroEvolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT) algorithms.
libs.desc.metade: An advanced evolutionary framework that dynamically optimizes the strategies and hyperparameters of Differential Evolution.
libs.desc.evoxbench: A platform offering instant benchmarking of evolutionary multi-objective optimization (EMO) algorithms in neural architecture search (NAS).
libs.desc.istratde: A GPU-accelerated Differential Evolution framework that enhances performance through individual-level strategy diversity.
libs.desc.evogo: A fully data-driven framework for black-box optimization, replacing manual heuristic operators by learning search behaviors from historical data.
libs.desc.evonas: A framework for neural architecture search, implemented with PyTorch. It supports supernet training, evolutionary multi-objective optimization, and seamless integration with modern computer vision training pipelines.
libs.desc.evocmo: A fully tensorized, GPU-accelerated multi-population evolutionary algorithm for efficiently solving constrained multi-objective optimization problems (CMOPs).
libs.desc.autopso: A meta-framework for automated Particle Swarm Optimization that automatically constructs PSO variants through black-box optimization on GPUs.
libs.desc.evococo: A multi-agent framework for semantics-guided automatic tensorization of evolutionary multiobjective optimization (EMO) software.
